Font files: New Hero in five OpenType weights (Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold), held in Font/. New Hero is a licensed typeface — confirm scope with Haleon brand/legal before new applications. Headings use Bold (authority) or Medium (empathy); never set body or small UI in Light. See Guideline.md §3.5.
